title: Best AI Tutor Apps for Conversation Practice in 2026: 11 Apps Compared
summary: Eleven AI tutor apps for speaking a new language, compared on conversations, feedback, free options, prices, and which platforms they run on. Then speak daily.
body_markdown:
*Updated November 2026 · Prices and ratings checked October 2026 (US)*


## The short answer


**For most learners, ISSEN is the best AI tutor app for practising conversation in a new language.** You pick a tutor with its own voice and personality, talk about whatever you want, and get corrected as you go. Tutors remember earlier sessions, so each conversation builds on the one before. It runs on the web, iOS and Android.


Other apps you'll see compared, and what each one is actually for:


- **Speak:** a structured AI course with speaking drills and AI conversation, for learners who want a lesson path.
- **Praktika:** conversations with AI avatar tutors.
- **Talkpal:** an AI tutor with a free daily allowance, in 130+ languages.
- **Langua:** AI conversation with natural voices and detailed feedback afterwards.
- **Fluently:** voice tutoring built around English for work and interviews.
- **Talkio AI:** AI tutors in 70+ languages and dialects.
- **LinguaLive:** realtime voice scenarios in the browser.
- **Fluently (by Engcraft):** a course plus voice role-plays, on iPhone.
- **Linguino and TalkHabit:** structured role-play and a short daily speaking habit.

## The apps


### 1. ISSEN — an AI tutor app for practising conversation


ISSEN is a realtime AI voice tutor for speaking practice through open-ended conversations. You choose a tutor with its own voice and personality, talk about whatever you want, and get corrected as you go. Tutors remember earlier sessions, so conversations build on each other instead of starting from zero. Words from your own conversations become flashcards, and a shadowing mode covers pronunciation separately. 4.7 stars on the App Store, 4.6 on Google Play; backed by Y Combinator.


- **Who it suits:** learners past the basics who want lots of unscripted speaking time
- **Free option:** 5 minutes of conversation
- **Price:** USD 10–29/month, depending on plan and country
- **Platforms:** web, iOS, Android
- **Note:** most useful once you can hold a basic conversation.


### 2. Speak — a structured course plus AI conversation


Speak pairs an expert-built speaking curriculum with conversations against its AI tutor, giving real-time feedback on pronunciation and phrasing. It is the most structured option here and one of the most-rated (4.8 on the App Store from 65,000+ ratings).


- **Who it suits:** learners who want guided lessons and conversation in one app
- **Free option:** 7-day trial
- **Price:** $17.99/month or $83.99/year (Premium, US App Store); varies by region
- **Platforms:** iOS, Android
- **Note:** six languages for English speakers, and no free tier after the trial.


### 3. Praktika — AI avatar conversations


Praktika's conversations are with animated AI avatar tutors in 14 languages, with a choice of personas and accents. It has the biggest following of any AI tutor app (4.8 on the App Store; 1.3M+ Google Play reviews) and can turn your own content into lessons.


- **Who it suits:** learners who find talking to a "face" easier than talking to a voice
- **Free option:** limited free plan (3 avatars)
- **Price:** from about $8/month on annual plans; App Store prices vary with promotions
- **Platforms:** iOS, Android
- **Note:** mobile only, and the free plan covers three avatars.


### 4. Talkpal — free tier and 130+ languages


Talkpal is a GPT-based tutor for open conversation and role-play in 130+ languages, on web and mobile. Its free tier of 10 minutes a day is enough for a daily habit.


- **Who it suits:** budget learners and less common languages
- **Free option:** 10 minutes a day, plus a 14-day Premium trial
- **Price:** $19.99/month or $119.99/year (US App Store)
- **Platforms:** web, iOS, Android
- **Note:** 10 free minutes a day.


### 5. Langua — natural voices and detailed feedback


Langua (from LanguaTalk) offers natural-sounding voices with a choice of dialects, a real-time call mode, and in-depth feedback after each conversation, in 23 languages. LanguaTalk also runs human tutoring if you want both.


- **Who it suits:** intermediate learners who want realistic conversation and thorough corrections
- **Free option:** 3 call-minutes a day
- **Price:** $19.99/month Standard; $29.99/month Unlimited (US App Store)
- **Platforms:** web, iOS, Android
- **Note:** 3 free call-minutes a day.


### 6. Fluently — voice tutoring for professional English


Fluently (Fluently, Inc., Y Combinator W24) is a hands-free voice tutor that gives feedback on pronunciation down to individual sounds, plus grammar and vocabulary fixes and native-style rephrasing. It includes work scenarios and mock interviews, and has 1M+ Google Play downloads.


- **Who it suits:** non-native English speakers preparing for work and interviews
- **Price:** not published on the website; the App Store lists several plans, monthly from $24.99
- **Platforms:** iOS, Android
- **Note:** built around English for professionals, and prices are not published on the site.


### 7. Talkio AI — AI tutors in 70+ languages and dialects


Talkio has 400+ AI tutor personalities across 70+ languages and dialects, including many regional Arabic varieties, Georgian, Swahili and Basque, with word-by-word pronunciation assessment and suggested replies when you're stuck.


- **Who it suits:** learners of less common languages or a specific dialect
- **Free option:** 7-day trial
- **Price:** from $14.99/month or $84.99/year (US App Store)
- **Platforms:** web, iOS, Android
- **Note:** trial only, with no free tier.


### 8. LinguaLive — scenario practice in the browser


LinguaLive is a real-time AI voice tutor in 9 languages with scenarios such as travel, job interviews and IELTS. Corrections appear without stopping the conversation, and it remembers past mistakes and goals. Pricing is published and simple.


- **Who it suits:** learners who want to practise in a browser without installing anything
- **Free option:** 10 minutes a day in week one, then 5 minutes a day
- **Price:** $14.99/month or $99.99/year
- **Platforms:** web, iOS, Android
- **Note:** practice minutes are capped, even on Pro.


### 9. Fluently (by Engcraft) — a course plus voice role-plays, on iPhone


A different app from Fluently above. It combines an A1–B2 course with goal-based AI voice-call role-plays (385 scenarios) in 29 languages, rating each reply and suggesting a more natural version.


- **Who it suits:** iPhone users who want a course and conversation practice for under $10 a month
- **Free option:** first 3 lessons free
- **Price:** $9.99/month or $39.99/year
- **Platforms:** iPhone, iPad, Mac
- **Note:** iPhone only.


### 10. Linguino — structured role-play lessons


Linguino turns each lesson into a scene: a briefing, the 2–3 key phrases, a role-play where the AI teacher plays the other person, then a replay with better ways to say things. You can pick regional accents, such as Mexico City or Madrid Spanish.


- **Who it suits:** beginners up to B1 who want structure inside conversation
- **Free option:** 3 short sessions a day
- **Price:** Starter $19/month
- **Platforms:** web
- **Note:** web only, and paid practice is capped by hours.


### 11. TalkHabit (beta) — a five-minute daily speaking habit


TalkHabit is built around speaking out loud for five minutes a day with an AI partner that remembers past conversations, adapts to your level and suggests tomorrow's topic. It also has a shadowing tool that works with any YouTube video.


- **Who it suits:** learners who struggle with consistency
- **Free option:** free in beta (5 minutes a day)
- **Platforms:** web
- **Note:** in beta, five minutes a day, and the language list is not published.


## Can't I just use ChatGPT's voice mode?


You can, and it's a reasonable free start. The difference with a dedicated tutor is consistency: tutor apps correct you every time rather than only when asked, keep track of your level and mistakes, and in apps like ISSEN, LinguaLive and TalkHabit they remember earlier conversations, so you're not starting over every session.


## Which AI tutor should you choose?


- **Complete beginner:** Speak or Linguino, for structure
- **Intermediate and want to talk freely:** ISSEN, Langua or Talkpal
- **Shy about speaking:** Praktika
- **English for work:** Fluently
- **A less common language or dialect:** Talkio AI or Talkpal
- **No budget:** Talkpal's free tier, or the free daily minutes on Langua and LinguaLive


Want options that aren't AI, such as human tutors and language exchange? See[the best apps to practice speaking a language](https://www.issen.com/blog/best-apps-to-practice-speaking-a-language/) .


## FAQ


**What is the best AI tutor app for practicing conversation in a new language?** ISSEN, for open-ended conversation with a tutor that remembers your earlier sessions, on web, iOS and Android. If you want a structured course instead, Speak; for avatar conversations, Praktika; for a free tier in the most languages, Talkpal.


**Are AI tutors good enough to replace a human tutor?** For daily speaking practice, yes for most learners: they're available any time and much cheaper. A human tutor is still better for cultural nuance and exam coaching, which is why many learners combine both.


**Which AI tutor apps work in a web browser?** ISSEN, Talkpal, Langua, Talkio AI, LinguaLive, Linguino and TalkHabit. Speak, Praktika and Fluently are mobile apps.


**Which AI tutor apps have a free plan?** Talkpal (10 minutes a day), Praktika (limited), Langua (3 call-minutes a day), LinguaLive (5–10 minutes a day) and TalkHabit (free in beta). Others offer a free trial.
